notes: Two supplied subordinators are added under rule 55 (t022, t040): both stand over clauses the Hebrew leaves asyndetic. The third, t028, is contiguous with the waw's and and is placed with it as rule 55's and that pair.
The waw of wəʿattāh takes therefore and ʿattāh takes now; the alternative of giving now therefore whole to ʿattāh is named in that unit's note.
hāʿām hazzeh has two article morphemes and one written determiner: hazzeh takes this under rule 41 and both articles are unrepresented under rule 47.
